parameters.content:
## QA dashboard

`GET /webhook/qa/dashboard` lists every project.
`GET /webhook/qa/dashboard?project=org/repo&branch=main` shows one project: pass-rate trend, failing tests, unstable and flaky tests, slowest tests and recent runs.

Read-only and unauthenticated, so browsers can open it. Keep n8n on localhost or behind your own login if the data is sensitive.

parameters.query:
-- Everything the dashboard shows, in one query. $1 = project ('' for the project list), $2 = branch.
WITH params AS (
  SELECT NULLIF($1, '') AS project, COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), 'main') AS branch
), projects AS (
  SELECT project, branch, count(*)::int AS runs, max(created_at) AS last_run_at,
         (array_agg(round(100.0 * passed / NULLIF(total - skipped, 0), 1) ORDER BY id DESC))[1] AS last_pass_rate,
         (array_agg(failed ORDER BY id DESC))[1] AS last_failed
  FROM test_runs
  GROUP BY project, branch
), runs AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.commit_sha, r.build_url, r.total, r.passed, r.failed, r.skipped, r.duration_ms, r.created_at,
         round(100.0 * r.passed / NULLIF(r.total - r.skipped, 0), 1) AS pass_rate
  FROM test_runs r JOIN params p ON r.project = p.project AND r.branch = p.branch
  ORDER BY r.id DESC
  LIMIT 20
), window_runs AS (
  SELECT id FROM runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10
), latest AS (
  SELECT max(id) AS id FROM runs
), history AS (
  SELECT test_id, status, retried, lag(status) OVER (PARTITION BY test_id ORDER BY run_id) AS prev_status
  FROM test_results
  WHERE run_id IN (SELECT id FROM window_runs) AND status <> 'skipped'
), unstable AS (
  SELECT test_id,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_status IS NOT NULL AND (prev_status = 'passed') <> (status = 'passed'))::int AS flips,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'passed')::int AS failures,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE retried)::int AS passed_on_retry,
         count(*)::int AS runs
  FROM history
  GROUP BY test_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT project FROM params) AS project,
  (SELECT branch FROM params) AS branch,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(p ORDER BY p.last_run_at DESC) FROM projects p), '[]'::json) AS projects,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(r ORDER BY r.id DESC) FROM runs r), '[]'::json) AS runs,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(u ORDER BY u.flips DESC, u.passed_on_retry DESC, u.test_id)
            FROM (SELECT * FROM unstable WHERE flips > 0 OR passed_on_retry > 0
                  ORDER BY flips DESC, passed_on_retry DESC LIMIT 10) u), '[]'::json) AS unstable,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.test_id)
            FROM (SELECT test_id, status, message FROM test_results
                  WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM latest) AND status IN ('failed', 'error')) t), '[]'::json) AS failing,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.duration_ms DESC)
            FROM (SELECT test_id, duration_ms FROM test_results
                  WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM latest) ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 10) t), '[]'::json) AS slowest;
